scores.evidence: M1 thin slice + spikes → M2 subscription billing → M3 usage billing + scale → M4 production readiness; "Depends on" column per milestone
scores.rationale: Phases build substrate (tenancy, money, ledger, DB) first, then features, then scale and prod, with explicit dependencies and spikes before dependent work.

scores.evidence: Milestone 1 delivers a thin slice in staging... one invoice, charges it through Stripe test mode, posts balanced ledger entries and delivers a signed webhook
scores.rationale: A real end-to-end slice with CI/CD, rollback and E2E test on every deploy comes first, though in staging rather than prod.

scores.evidence: D1 ... Hard | Design partners need a processor Stripe doesn't cover, or want us to handle payouts
scores.rationale: Decisions D1–D13 list options, reversibility and a revisit trigger, with assumptions A1–A8 and default answers for open questions.

scores.evidence: Week 1: T1, T5, T6, T9, L1–L3 and all spikes start... T14 is on the critical path
scores.rationale: Within M1, foundations, tenancy, RLS and money primitives and risk spikes precede leaf features like dashboard, and critical path is identified.

scores.evidence: T6 RLS policy template and billing_app role without BYPASSRLS; T19 isolation suite; egress proxy in T15
scores.rationale: Security has concrete work in M1 (RLS, key auth, isolation suite, SSRF block, secrets) and later M2 scoped keys, M3, M4 pen test and break-glass.

scores.evidence: T4 Wire up OpenTelemetry... A staging trace shows API request → DB → enqueued job → worker execution under one trace ID
scores.rationale: Observability and invariant checker v0 are in M1, with alerts extended in M3 and M4 runbooks, though some later phase detail is lighter.

scores.evidence: terraform apply from CI builds staging from empty, and a second plan shows no changes
scores.rationale: Terraform, CI image digests, migrations, seeded synthetic data generator, docker-compose, and deterministic invoices are threaded through phases.

scores.evidence: T11 A chaos test kills the worker mid-batch of 10k due subscriptions... exactly 10k invoices, with 0 duplicates
scores.rationale: Idempotency, chaos tests, rollback and circuit breakers appear in M1, with failover and timeout chaos in M3 and DR drill in M4.

scores.evidence: AI-specific concerns: Not applicable. The system has no AI or model components.
scores.rationale: The plan explicitly declares the AI layer not applicable and adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: ClickHouse usage store | S1 fails, or sustained > 20k events/s
scores.rationale: Section 17 lists deferred items with triggers, plus M1 stubs and non-goals and deliberate shortcuts with payback conditions.

note: Exceptionally thorough plan that meets every rubric dimension with concrete content; only minor gap is that the walking skeleton runs in staging, not prod.
